summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Mahmoud Salem, an Egyptian author. It gives his lifespan (1931 to 24 February 2013) and describes him as an eminent writer known for children's books and mystery series.
one_line: Mahmoud Salem was an Egyptian author (1931–2013) known for children's books and mystery series.
key_facts: Mahmoud Salem was an Egyptian author.
Mahmoud Salem is described as an eminent Egyptian author.
Mahmoud Salem was known for children's books.
Mahmoud Salem was known for mystery series.
